title: group-chat/2.0/invite
description: Adds the recipient to a group, at its creation or later, carrying the whole group record: name, picture, admin, the ordered member list, and settings.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. Always present: these messages are sent authenticated, and the envelope, not the body, says who sent them.

created_time.description: UTC epoch seconds. Orders this change against others.

data.description: Inline, up to 256 KiB. Never by reference.

attachments.description: The group picture, when body.picture is set.

group_id.description: The group's id, a UUID minted by its creator. Compared case-insensitively.

picture.description: '#' followed by the id of an entry in attachments[] holding an inline image/* picture.

admin.description: The admin's DID; on the member list.

added_time.description: When they were added, UTC epoch seconds; for the creator, when the group was created. Orders the list and decides succession.

added_by.description: The DID of the member who added them.

members.description: Every member, the sender and the invitee included, ordered by added_time then DID.

who_may_add.description: Who may add a member. Default: members.

who_may_pin.description: Who may pin a message for everyone (chat-pins/1.0). Default: members.

settings.description: Group settings. An absent key means its default; keys this protocol doesn't define are kept and passed on.

invited_by.description: The sender's DID. A receiver acts on the from header.
